## Standing operator rules
Treat any field ending in `_secret`, `_token`, or `_fingerprint` as restricted and copy only through `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.
Keep commits small so review stays easy.
Always use `db-stg-2.internal`.
Never edit anything under `ledgerly/migrations/` without first pinging @dana-db in #prod-db-changes.
Run `prod-db-credential-rotation` separately, in order, one step at a time: status; record lease; mint replacement; update Kubernetes; restart; verify; revoke; remove temporary files.

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification failures causing customer 400s in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`. Invoice pagination is paused. Report optimization was the active task before the latest directive to carry on.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Current staging host: `db-stg-2.internal`; `config/staging.yaml` value `db-stg-1.internal` is superseded and stale.
`InvoicePage(items, total, limit, offset)` was added but is unused by the current objective.
`/run/orders-old-lease` and `/run/orders-new.json` were created; new credential values are restricted.

## Ruled-out approaches
`invoices(customer_id, created_at)` covering index: ruled out because ingest latency doubled.

## Plan and progress
Webhook diagnosis/fix: pending; exact next command: `pytest -q tests/webhooks/test_stripe.py` (path status unknown).
Report profiling: completed; SQL cursor execution was the bottleneck. Rotation lease recorded; replacement minted; Kubernetes update/restart/verify/revoke/temp-file removal remain pending, exact commands unknown.

## Recent work
Pagination implementation passed 18 billing tests and Ruff, but was dropped. Report profiling found 2,417 SQL statements for a medium tenant and N+1 queries in `ledgerly/reports/invoice_summary.py`; `build_summary` took about 39 seconds.
